prose: Forbes reports Tutor, which is training a frontier robot foundation model and builds AI warehouse robots, has raised a $75 million Series B led by a16z, taking total funding to $117 million. Another large check for the robotics foundation-model thesis - generalist warehouse labor remains one of the strongest pull markets for embodied AI.
highlights: Tutor raised a $75M Series B led by a16z ($117M total) for its robot foundation model and warehouse robots
Robotics foundation models keep attracting frontier-scale checks
